name: mobile-prototyper
description: Turn a spec, architecture and design docs into a rough draw.io prototype of a native mobile app (Android, iOS or both): numbered screens, their states and the arrows between them. Answers what the documents already answer (with your approval), asks you the rest, draws the flow as an editable .drawio file, and offers an optional design phase (design system and final-look screens) once the flow is locked.

interface.shortDescription: Docs in, draw.io sketch of your Android / iOS flow out.
interface.longDescription: Reads your spec, architecture and design documents, proposes answers from them for your approval, asks only the questions that remain, then draws the screens, their states and the flow between them as a rough, editable draw.io sketch: a one-page wireflow or click-through pages. Once the flow is locked it can add a design system and final-look Android / iOS screens, and it ends with a handoff package for native implementation.
defaultPrompt: Sketch the onboarding flow from docs/SPEC.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
Check which of my docs are available and start a mobile prototype.
